reviewType: AI-assisted methodology review, not independent expert certification

decisions.calendarBasedCoverage: accepted as a conservative local missingness policy; no statistical calibration claim
decisions.equalValidYearWeighting: accepted for the explicitly defined historical normal; preserve conditional snow-depth interpretation
decisions.midnightCrossingDaylight: accepted bug correction; sampling must include daytime hours when sunset wraps past midnight
decisions.denaliJuneTemperature: accept the recomputed 10.364046979437957 C as the output of the corrected model-cell calculation, not as an independently validated station or trail temperature
decisions.rounding: retain the existing raw eligibility decision followed by published rounding and existing best-month selection; changing threshold or rounding order requires a separate decision
decisions.snowReviewThreshold: retain conservative local screening and existing holds; no glacier-classification or hold-release authority

migrationConditions: Use only the hash-pinned reports below and verify their canonical source hashes against the published sources; do not use the superseded Denali report from the ten-point run.
Retain null metrics and per-metric coverage through the versioned snapshot/schema/export chain; no fabricated samples, imputation or weight redistribution.

Do not copy historical confidence or interannual variability into a newly processed snapshot as though recomputed. Recompute them consistently or explicitly retain an unavailable/provisional status without overstating confidence.
Preserve all existing destination holds, caveats, noindex status and false release approvals. No new route-safety or whole-region claims.
Retain the other 305 destinations unchanged and identify each destination's actual aggregation version; never label the whole catalogue as migrated.

Validate public output, provenance, deterministic reproduction, tests and build before any deployment. Recommendation eligibility and best-month sets must match the reviewed result; unexpected changes return to review.
Store durable evidence or a durable lossless equivalent before temporary Actions artifacts expire; link original hashes and processing versions.
